recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes a direct semantic contradiction in the active search narrative without expanding the issue scope or requiring broader SearchParameter changes.
issue_request: FHIR-8776 was Published/Persuasive and asked FHIR-core search to define :above and :below for reference search parameters that traverse strict partOf-style hierarchies, including Location.partOf, Organization.partOf, and Encounter.partOf.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by git-svn commit 26c933c82f1c19283a7d2e1642aa3a2abe112085 (svn revision 13269), which added the searching-hierarchies text and circular-reference hierarchy lists. Current source also has hierarchy markers on the relevant same-type partOf reference elements.
additional_context: FHIR-27858 later expanded above/below modifier descriptions with correct parent wording for reference :above. FHIR-40315 then clarified circular hierarchy wording but inadvertently changed the :above reference summary from parents to children, contradicting FHIR-8776 examples and nearby current examples. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Changed source/search.html in the reference :above modifier section from “children” to “ancestors,” preserving the already-correct :below wording and the structural hierarchy markers/lists.
source_changes: source/search.html: changed the reference :above modifier summary to say exact matches and ancestors, aligning it with the Procedure location and MedicationAdministration encounter hierarchy examples.
